newsitem.title: VATICAN: Vatican calls child pornography criminal act.
newsitem.headline: Vatican calls child pornography criminal act.

text.p: Child pornography and sex tourism should be made a criminal offence, the Vatican said in a speech to the United Nations Human Rights Commission which was released on Thursday.

In the speech, which was delivered in Geneva earlier this week, a Vatican delegation expressed concern over a report by the U.N. Commission on the growth of child pornography and the organised sale of children worldwide.
"These realities...are compromising the moral health of those who abandon themselves to it. But an individual who degrades himself...degrades all of humanity," the delegation said.
"Wanting to criminalise such practices is a reaction which cannot but be encouraged and supported," it said.
The delegation also urged the Commission to seek additional information on child pornography and prostitution from specialised research institutions.
The Vatican has often condemned child pornography and prostitution. Last month, Pope John Paul called for a concerted international effort to put a stop to the recent growth of sex tourism in Asia.
